note: Written before any retrieval output was inspected. Development queries may inform tuning; test queries are held out and must not. Each query is run through the same goal parser as Discover, so retrieval sees the goal's target text (known-skill clauses removed).
relevance_rule: A course is relevant when its main subject is the learning topic the query asks for and it respects explicit constraints in the query (for example 'beginner' or a named tool). A course that only uses the topic in passing, or is about a different subject that shares words, is not relevant.

queries.text: I know Python and SQL. Help me move into machine learning.
How do computers learn to recognise images with neural networks?
I want to build predictive models from data.
Teach me deep learning with TensorFlow.
I'm good at statistics and want to learn regression and classification algorithms.
A beginner-friendly introduction to machine learning concepts.
Suggest a path from beginner to advanced data analytics.
I want to make interactive dashboards in Tableau.
How do I analyse spreadsheets of sales numbers to find trends?
I know Excel, help me become a data analyst.
Learn to clean messy datasets and visualise the results.
I want to learn cloud computing from the basics.
Prepare for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam.
How do I deploy applications with Docker and Kubernetes?
I know Linux and networking, help me move into cloud engineering.
Renting servers and storage over the internet instead of owning hardware.

edge_cases.name: Empty goal
edge_cases.expected: Rejected with a validation message; no recommendations.

edge_cases.name: Unrelated subject

request.goal: I want to learn to play the violin.

edge_cases.expected: No skill chart or path; an 'unsupported track' warning; any courses shown are search results only.

edge_cases.name: Filters with no matches

request.goal: I want to learn cloud computing from the basics.

edge_cases.expected: Zero courses, a 'loosen a filter' warning, and an honest empty path instead of padded results.

edge_cases.name: Negated known skill

request.goal: I don't know Python yet but I know SQL. I want to get into machine learning.

edge_cases.expected: SQL is confirmed; Python is not counted as known and stays in the gap.

edge_cases.name: Ambiguous track

request.goal: I want to work with data in the cloud.

edge_cases.expected: The student is asked to choose between the matching tracks; no path is guessed.
